body.p: When you clone a repository that contains submodules, the Git Client also initializes and clones the submodules. When you pull changes from the remote repository, the submodules are also updated. This behavior depends on the Update all submodules after pulling changes from the remote repository option in Options Preferences Plugins Git Client . This option is enabled by default.

When you check out a branch for a parent repository with submodules, the Git Client also performs a checkout of the submodules at the index in the parent repository to match the repository state at that time.

To open and work with a Git submodule, use Submodule from the Vertical Ellipsis menu and select the submodule from the drop-down menu. If the submodule is modified and appears in the Unstaged files area, you can also use Open from the context menu.
The tooltip for a modified submodule in the Unstaged files area shows information about the currently tracked commit and the previously tracked commit.
